name: TotalSegmentator Batch Pipeline
purpose: A batch medical-imaging pipeline that ingests raw 3D CT/MRI volumes to Backblaze B2, runs TotalSegmentator locally to produce multi-label masks covering 100+ anatomical structures plus per-structure volumetric statistics, and writes the masks and stats back to a B2 derived prefix — building a scalable segmented imaging dataset with B2 as the sole storage layer.
tagline: Segment 100+ anatomical structures into Backblaze B2 — at PACS scale.

features.title: Study Library
features.summary: browse, create, edit, delete and segment CT/MRI studies

features.title: Segmentation
features.summary: run TotalSegmentator locally to produce a 100+ structure multi-label mask

features.title: Volumetric Stats
features.summary: per-structure volume (mL), bounding box and CT Hounsfield stats as JSON

features.title: Dashboard
features.summary: studies processed, structures segmented, and source-to-derived write amplification

features.title: Bulk Volume Ingest
features.summary: drag-and-drop bulk upload of NIfTI volumes to the B2 source prefix

features.title: Settings
features.summary: theme plus labelled demo preference fields

b2_surface.why: the browser bulk-uploads large source volumes directly to B2 (source prefix), bypassing the Function payload cap
write the study record.json and the derived stats.json, and (multipart) the segmentation mask .nii.gz
the Study Library, the source-volume picker, and the dashboard write-amplification aggregates
cheap per-object sizes for the amplification metric, and the /health connectivity probe
stream the source volume to a local temp file for segmentation, and read the record and stats JSON
download and inline-view the mask, source volume, and stats
remove every object under a study's prefix on delete

stack.web: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Recharts
stack.api: FastAPI, Python 3.12+, boto3, Pydantic v2, TotalSegmentator, nibabel, NumPy

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID
env_vars.note: B2 application key ID (**keyID** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY
env_vars.note: B2 application key (**applicationKey**) — shown once at creation

env_vars.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
env_vars.note: bucket unique name (**Bucket Unique Name** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_REGION
env_vars.note: the region inside the bucket's **Endpoint** (`s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com`); the S3 endpoint is derived from it

env_vars.name: B2_PUBLIC_URL_BASE
env_vars.note: public object base URL, when the bucket is public

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.note: separate-origin deploys only; Next.js inlines it at build time

env_vars.name: TS_DEVICE
env_vars.note: segmentation device override: auto|cpu|gpu|mps (default auto — CUDA, then CPU; MPS is opt-in as nnU-Net support is weak)
